sense: step three: the house on the bench
definition: The plan on the bench: one house, placed room by room on the structural grid and drawn from its record, with the critic's findings on it. Change a room and the plan is placed and judged again.
basis: Editorial. docs/workbench.md: every edit changes the declared record "and a debounced `POST /api/plan/evaluate` carries the whole record back", and the sheet "draws only from record + placement". README.md: geometry is "Bay-grid slicing with the relaxations counted", and the bench shows "the drawing with the critique on it". VISION.md: a plan developer "can move a wall and watch what it breaks.", and "Every check distinguishes evaluated-and-failed, evaluated-and-passed, and" could-not-evaluate.

surface.what: One house on the bench: placed, drawn from its record, and judged.
read: Rooms are drawn where the placement put them; select one to see its record.
Findings are fatal, serious or minor; what could not be judged is counted apart and never read as passed.
Change a room and the plan is placed and judged again.
Where the placement breaks a fact of the house type, the plan is refused and the conflict named instead of drawn.
